known_limits: Live network metadata and rename functionality is not fully verified: final full upstream suite has 16 failures and 1 setup error, including three edition-count assertions. No universal platform-only root cause or full-suite 100 percent claim is justified.
Python 3.12.9 is the measured runtime. Python 3.8/3.9 entry-point fallback is source-compatible by inspection only; Conan build requires Python >=3.10 for pytest 9.
The finish command still exits 1 for legacy packaging/staging checks and repository-wide draft telemetry. This is disclosed separately from its genuine successful local W3.

Two early W3 failure backups were overwritten by subsequent runs. They were relabeled as intermediate success records, and only tool-displayed failure excerpts survive; those excerpts are not original complete raw logs.
